title: La wadaag sheekadaada
description: U sheeg ardayda, hay'adaha iyo jaamacadaha kale sida ay dhab ahaan u ahayd inaad FursadHub ku shaqeyso.

form.title: Qor markhaatigaaga
form.moderationNotice: Gudbintu waxay hadalkaaga u dirtaa kooxda FursadHub si ay u eegaan. Waxba kama muuqdaan bogga dadweynaha ilaa uu maamulaha daabaco, hadalkaagana waa la daabacayaa sidii aad u qortay ama lama daabacayo.
form.displayNameHint: Kanu waa magaca ku xiga hadalkaaga. Emaylka akoonkaaga waligiis lama daabaco.

errors.TESTIMONIAL_ALREADY_SUBMITTED: Waxaad hore u leedahay markhaati eegis sugaya ama la daabacay.
errors.TESTIMONIAL_INVALID_TRANSITION: Markhaatigaas si taas ah xaaladdiisa looma beddeli karo.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Hubi goobaha la calaamadeeyay oo isku day mar kale.
errors.generic: Markhaatigaaga lama gudbin karin. Isku day mar kale.
errors.TESTIMONIAL_ROLE_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Akoonkaagu weli ma laha door FursadHub oo aan sheeko ku tilmaami karno.

form.sharingAsHint: FursadHub waxay tan ka soo qaadataa akoonkaaga, si sheekadaada had iyo jeer loogu daabaco doorka aad dhab ahaan haysato. Halkan lagama beddeli karo.

errors.nameRequired: Geli magaca lagu daabacayo hadalkaaga agtiisa.
errors.ratingRequired: Dooro qiimayn u dhaxaysa 1 ilaa 5 xiddigood.

ineligible.title: Weli lama heli karo
ineligible.body: Sheekooyinka waxaa lagu daabacaa door FursadHub oo dhab ah. Marka aad yeelato boggaaga ardayga ama door shaqaale oo jaamacad ama hay'ad ah, halkan ayaad kaaga wadaagi kartaa.
